name: 08629 · Trenton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08629 (Trenton) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08629 (Trenton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
